input_file.description: The path to the corrupted pcap/pcapng file to repair.

output_file.description: The path for the fixed output file. If omitted or null, defaults to 'fixed_' prepended to the input filename.

force_pcapng.description: If true, forces pcapfix to repair the input file as PCAPNG format (--pcapng).

data_link_type.description: The Data Link Type number to select/override (0-255). Default is 1 (LINKTYPE_ETHERNET).

enable_deep_scan.description: If true, forces deep scan mode to search for packets beyond the initial snaplen limit (-d).

enable_soft_mode.description: If true, switches to soft mode for more tolerant packet detection (-s).

verbosity.description: Verbosity level. 0 for normal, higher for more output (e.g., 2 for verbose).
